shots.seen: A man in dark clothing stands beside a motorcycle on a quiet street at night under a streetlight.
A man rides a motorcycle down a wet street lined with glowing storefronts at dusk.
Seen from directly behind, a man rides a motorcycle through a foggy, grey city intersection.
Seen from behind, a man rides a motorcycle down a street lined with watching pedestrians and hanging lanterns.

overall: Neither the third-person perspective nor the visual style is fully consistent across all four shots, as the camera angles vary early on and shot 3 looks like an untextured 3D blockout compared to the cel-shaded cartoon style of the others. The biggest weakness is the abrupt shift to a rough grey-box aesthetic in the third shot and the failure of the second shot to visually depict the specific action of getting on the bike.
